subject: Intent recognition kickoff — activity signals API
body: Team, kickoff for Intent Recognition in the data-platforms portfolio. We're productizing our sensor-ML tooling: models that infer user activities from device sensor streams. The pipeline stages are already defined in the open-source release — sensor data as AnnotatedRecordingCollections, mediapipe-based processing, conversion to SequenceExamples, then TensorFlow training and inference/metrics. Product target: an activity-signal API for two internal partners who today hand-roll their own classifiers. Milestones: ADL-dataset pipeline repro by end of April (the converter binary exists, so this is mostly build plumbing); partner-data pilot in June; go/no-go on the API for mid-July. Known annoyance up front: the whole thing builds under bazel with MEDIAPIPE_DISABLE_GPU=1 and C++17 flags, so getting CI green is a real task, not a checkbox. Alina owns staffing. — Dmitri
